contract_gaps.moving_pin: The official vendor-hosted OpenAPI URL is not content-addressed. The declared SHA-256 fails closed when GitBook changes the bytes and must be deliberately re-pinned.
contract_gaps.streaming: Five user-token endpoints return text/event-stream only and are explicitly excluded from the static JSON REST packs.
contract_gaps.non_user_auth: Seventeen operations require internal, staff, integration, or installation credentials and are not falsely advertised as personal-token capabilities.
contract_gaps.unpaged_collections: Twelve items-array responses expose no page or limit parameter in the pinned contract. They remain single bounded responses and make no completeness claim.
contract_gaps.page_source_scope: The Source projects the top-level pages array. Child pages remain nested, so the declaration is intentionally filtered and never infers tombstones.
contract_gaps.page_version: RevisionPage requires id and title but has no mandatory version field: createdAt and updatedAt are optional. The Source therefore declares version.kind none and relies on its documented hash basis.
